label: airFiber 11 High-Band Complete Link
description: 10.7-11.7 GHz licensed high-band airFiber 11 backhaul link: radio plus 811 mm dish antenna. 1.2+ Gbps throughput, 300+ km range, 50 V 4-pair passive PoE or terminal-block DC. Ports on the radio: 1x GbE data RJ45 + 1x 10/100 MbE management RJ45.
